name: [Negative] Withholding of Funds
description: Users experience difficulty in withdrawing their money, with some even reporting loss of funds due to technical glitches and poor customer support.

name: [Negative] App Crashes and Withholds Funds
description: Users experienced issues with withdrawing funds, with some transactions being debited but not credited, and customer support failing to address the issue. App crashes also occurred when attempting to withdraw funds.

name: [Negative] App Crashes and Refund Issues
description: Users report frequent app crashes, delays in FD processing, and difficulties with refunds, resulting in frustration and mistrust of the platform. The majority of users experience these issues while trying to withdraw their money.
